risks.title: Cybersecurity
risks.score_rationale: The company is exposed to risks of cyberattacks and data breaches, which could have significant consequences on reputation and operations (Item 1A, Risk Factors)

risks.title: Macroeconomic Conditions
risks.score_rationale: Current macroeconomic conditions include inflation, high interest rates, and a challenging housing market, reducing demand for home warranties (Item 7, MD&A)

risks.title: Competition
risks.score_rationale: The company operates in a highly competitive home warranty market and a competitive home services industry (Item 1A, Risk Factors)

risks.title: Tariffs and Trade Regulations
risks.score_rationale: Changes in U.S. import tariffs and new trade restrictions are increasing costs for parts and household appliances (Item 7, MD&A)

risks.title: Dependence on Contractors
risks.score_rationale: The company relies heavily on its network of contractor service providers for service delivery, which could affect quality and availability (Item 1A, Risk Factors)

risks.title: Weather Conditions and Seasonality
risks.score_rationale: Demand for services and financial results are affected by weather conditions and seasonal variations, particularly for HVAC service requests (Item 7, MD&A)

risks.title: Labor Availability and Costs
risks.score_rationale: The company depends on its ability to attract and retain qualified employees and faces labor availability challenges (Item 1A, Risk Factors)

ai_positioning.summary: The company FTDR does not mention artificial intelligence or machine learning in its 10-K report.
